ios.desc:
GymDose is a supplement tracker built around your training. Creatine and pre-workout on training days, magnesium and vitamins on rest days, each with a reminder at the right time.

Set up your stack once and GymDose works out what's due today. Choose training days, rest days, specific weekdays or every few days for each supplement, then log a dose with one tap.

TRAINING DAYS AND REST DAYS
• Separate schedules for training days and rest days, plus specific weekdays or every N days
• Four time slots: Morning, Pre-Workout, Post-Workout and Night
• One reminder per time slot, so everything due at once arrives as a single notification
• Supplements you take every few days also get a heads-up on the day they're due
• Your own dose and unit for each supplement

LOG WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Interactive Home Screen widgets: tick off a dose right from the widget (iOS 17 and later)
• Lock Screen widgets, plus a Control Center button on iOS 18 and later
• Tap "Mark as taken" on a reminder and you're done
• Ask Siri or run a Shortcut to log a whole time slot
• A Live Activity keeps today's doses on your Lock Screen

STAY CONSISTENT
• Streaks with milestones at 7, 30 and 100 days, plus a streak card to share
• A calendar heatmap of the days you hit and the days you missed
• Export your history to CSV

YOUR WHOLE STACK IN ONE PLACE
• Creatine, whey protein, omega-3, magnesium, vitamin D, zinc, caffeine, ZMA, peptides or anything else you take
• 19 3D supplement icons, so each one is easy to spot
• Optional Apple Health sync saves the nutrients from your logged doses to Health
• Back up to a file and restore it whenever you need to, for example from iCloud Drive
• Dark mode that follows your iPhone, with dark versions of the themes
• Available in 13 languages

FREE AND PRO
The free plan includes 3 supplements, and every schedule type and reminder is free. GymDose Pro adds:
• Unlimited supplements
• Editing past days
• Full history: stats beyond the current month and a breakdown per supplement
• 5 extra color themes
• Stock tracking with low-stock and refill alerts

GymDose is made by one developer who trains and uses it every day. Feedback is always welcome.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I kept forgetting my supplements while cutting, so I built an app

quotes.text:
Hey guys,
I wanted to share something I’ve been working on for the last months because it came directly from my own training routine.

I lost 45 kg over the past couple of years, and along the way I started using a lot of daily supplements — creatine, vitamins, omega-3, etc. The annoying part was that I constantly forgot whether I took them or not. Some days I took stuff twice, some days not at all.

So I built my own supplement tracker app with a clean, minimal interface.

No ads, no clutter, no over-complicated habit tracker stuff.

Just:
* See your supplements for the day
* Tap to mark them
* Custom reminders
* Simple daily timeline

It’s called GymDose and I decided to publish it since it helped me stay consistent:
 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gymdose-supplement-tracker/id6756020237

If anyone here wants to try premium for free, just ask for it — I can generate promo codes. I’m a solo dev and this started as a personal project, so I’m happy to share it.

If you have any feedback, features you’d like added, or just want to roast my UI, go for it 
Stay consistent.
